title: Outcome denominator
prompt: Implement `summary(rows)` returning wins, losses, draws, unknown and rate. Read `derived`; rate is WIN/(WIN+LOSS), or None. Example: WIN plus missing gives rate 1 and unknown 1.
tests:
s=summary([{'derived':'WIN'},{'derived':'LOSS'},{'derived':'DRAW'},{}])
assert s=={'wins':1,'losses':1,'draws':1,'unknown':1,'rate':.5}, 'Draws and unknowns must be reported separately'
assert summary([{}])['rate'] is None, 'No decisive outcomes means no rate'
hint: Use an explicit mapping for the three known outcome strings.

tests:
lo,hi=wilson(5,10)
assert abs(lo-.2365895936)<1e-8 and abs(hi-.7634104064)<1e-8, 'Use the Wilson correction, not the simple normal interval'
assert wilson(0,0) is None, 'No observed games gives no interval'
lo,hi=wilson(10,10)
assert 0<lo<1 and abs(hi-1)<1e-9, 'Ten wins still leave uncertainty'
hint: Compute p only after the n=0 case.
solution:
import math

def wilson(wins,n,z=1.96):
    if n==0:
        return None
    p=wins/n
    den=1+z*z/n
    centre=(p+z*z/(2*n))/den
    half=z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/den
    return centre-half,centre+half

title: A simplified SIM gate
prompt: Implement `sim_gate(identity,pooled_low,mortar_rate)`: all must be available; require identity True, pooled_low>0, mortar_rate>=.45. Example: True,.01,.45 passes. This is only a teaching subset of the real ladder.
tests:
assert sim_gate(True,.01,.45), 'Inclusive Mortar bar and positive lower bound pass'
assert not sim_gate(True,0,.9), 'A lower bound touching zero fails'
assert not sim_gate(True,None,.9), 'Missing uncertainty evidence cannot pass'
assert not sim_gate(False,.1,.9), 'Identity is independently required'
solution:
def sim_gate(identity,pooled_low,mortar_rate):
    return identity is True and pooled_low is not None and mortar_rate is not None and pooled_low>0 and mortar_rate>=.45

title: Offline safety-stage decision
prompt: Implement `trial_status(observed,minimum,alarm)` returning 'review alarm' first if alarm, otherwise 'collect more' below minimum, else 'eligible for review'. Example: 29,30,False needs more. Return text only.
tests:

assert trial_status(60,60,False)=='eligible for review', 'Use configurable block size'
assert trial_status(150,150,False)=='eligible for review', 'Completion supports review, not automatic deployment'
